name: Lofty IDX
author: Lofty Inc.

sections.description:
OVERVIEW

Lofty IDX is a robust WordPress plugin designed to integrate IDX/MLS property listings seamlessly into your website, allowing real estate agents to display current property listings and capture lead information effortlessly. This plugin is ideal for agents looking to enhance their website’s functionality with up-to-date property information and lead generation tools.

PLUG-AND-PLAY

Lofty IDX comes pre-configured with sample listings, a Lofty Menu, and page groups, allowing you to preview your site’s layout and perfect it before connecting your MLS feed. Simply install it on your WordPress site and start customizing.

ALL STANDARD MLS IDX PAGES WITH SEO

If you already have a live WordPress site, change management is a breeze – all you have to do is update the URLS of your old and new pages. .

PERFECT INTEGRATION WITH LOFTY CRM

When leads engage with content on your WordPress website, like viewing or saving listings, their activities will be tracked in the Lofty CRM. This means that you can see what listings the lead is looking at, saving, and searching on the WordPress site in the lead’s timeline in Lofty.

SETUP GUIDE

Visit our Quick Start Guide

CONTACT

You can contact us through send us an email wpidxsupport@lofty.com

Troubleshooting

  • If you encounter issues with activation, ensure the API key is valid.
  • For configuration errors, check Help Center for guidance.
  • Contact wpidxsupport@lofty.com for assistance.
sections.installation:
If you are a Lofty user, or building a website on behalf of a Lofty user:
1. Go to Lofty > Marketplace to purchase the WordPress IDX plugin and connect your WordPress domain.
2. Install and activate the Lofty IDX plugin through WordPress.
3. Navigate to Lofty > Website > Settings > API Key to retrieve your unique API Key, then paste it into WordPress > Settings > Lofty IDX Settings.
4. Click the Lofty IDX Plugin menu to access the Lofty-synced pages, Shortcodes, and Customizations.

If you are not a Lofty user yet:
Please email us at wpidxsupport@lofty.com for assistance.
sections.faq:
What is IDX?

IDX stands for Internet Data Exchange, a system allowing real estate agents to display property listings from the Multiple Listing Service (MLS) on their websites.

Does this plugin work with all MLSs?

Yes, we cover over 400 MLSs across the United States, ensuring broad compatibility with various regional systems.

Does this plugin work with Lofty CRM?

Yes, the plugin integrates seamlessly with Lofty CRM. Leads are automatically imported, and activity tracking functions are the same as those on the current Lofty website.
